Access.name: loadCodAgenteTitolareCogestioneCliente
Access.Query:
select lpad(COD_AGENT_TITRE,10,'0') from SOGG_TRKEVEN.DETT_ACCOR_COGEST where COD_RUOLO_AGENT = 'BC' and sysdate between DAT_ATTIVZ_ACCOR and DAT_REVO_ACCOR and GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and COD_AGENT_COGEST = ( select COD_AGENT from CLL.LEGM_PROSPCT_AGENT_COGEST where COD_RUOLO_AGENT = 'BC' and ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE =
codPotenziale and COD_AGENT =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and rownum = 1 union select COD_AGENT from CLL.LEGM_CLI_AGENT_COGEST where COD_RUOLO_AGENT = 'BC' and CLI_C =
codMediolanum and COD_AGENT =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and rownum = 1 )

Access.name: loadAccordoCogestione
Access.Query:
select COD_STATO_ACCOR, lpad(COD_AGENT_TITRE,10,'0'), lpad(COD_AGENT_COGEST,10,'0') from SOGG_TRKEVEN.DETT_ACCOR_COGEST where COD_RUOLO_AGENT = 'BC' and GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and sysdate between DAT_ATTIVZ_ACCOR and DAT_REVO_ACCOR and (COD_AGENT_TITRE =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode or COD_AGENT_COGEST =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode)

Access.name: loadLastAccessData
Access.Query: select GSTD_M_NOM_ULT_MODF, to_char(GSTD_D_ULT_MODF_RECORD,'dd-mm-yyyy hh24:mi:ss') from cll.CEPE_CLI_PROSPECT_RETE_REP where ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = ?

Access.name: loadCellulareMailAgente
Access.Query: select TELCELL.TELEFONO , MAIL.E_MAIL from ARC_ANAG_SOGGETTO AN left outer join ARC_TELEFONO_SOGGETTO TELCELL on TELCELL.N_ANAG_SOGG = AN.N_ANAG_SOGG and TELCELL.N_TIPO_TELEF = 1 and TELCELL.FLG_ANNULLATO = 'N' left outer join ARC_MAIL_SOGGETTO MAIL on MAIL.N_ANAG_SOGG = AN.N_ANAG_SOGG AND MAIL.FLG_ANNULLATO = 'N' where AN.FLG_ANNULLATO = 'N' and right('0000000000'||AN.COD_SOGGETTO,10) = ?

Access.name: popolaDatiUserDestinatario
Access.Query:
SELECT AGE_M_NOME FROM CLL.AGE WHERE AGE_C =
codUserDestinatario
